result.title: Compatible Likelihoods for Flow Matching on Manifolds
result.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
result.summary: On the simplest non-Euclidean manifold, the 1D flat torus, we exhibit a distribution where a recently proposed extension of Riemannian flow matching is globally optimized by a velocity field that pushes samples away from the data distribution. We trace this failure mode to a property we call compatibility; a likelihood-based flow matching objective is compatible if its population minimizer recovers the marginal velocity field induced by the data and coupling. We give a general condition for compatibility, apply it to existing methods, and bound the worst-case error in terms of a residual component vanishing under compatibility. Next, we note that existing compatible objectives put density on velocities that are infeasible on compact manifolds. We propose an objective built from an exponential family over endpoints, with the conditional velocity as sufficient statistic, which is both compatible and supported only on feasible velocities. This manifests as a reweighting of the flow matching loss which, on constant-curvature manifolds, treats errors in flow speed and direction differently. Empirically, our method recovers the correct velocity field on the test case, outperforms prior methods on high-dimensional product tori, and obtains substantial NLL improvements over prior work on two of four standard geospatial benchmarks on the sphere at moderate runtime overhead. On a large dataset of high-dimensional human poses, our method outperforms prior work according to sample-based metrics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究流匹配（flow matching）在流形上的似然目标设计：在 1D 平坦环面上指出已有 Riemannian flow matching 扩展会被整体优化为把样本推离数据的速度场，提出「compatibility」判据来刻画总体最优解是否恢复数据与耦合诱导的边缘速度场，并给出误差界，进而以端点的指数族目标构造既 compatible 又只支撑在可行速度上的新目标。
AI.relevance_reason: 若 LVR 用 flow matching 或扩散在受约束的 latent 空间（如球面、归一化隐状态）中生成推理状态，其「目标是否恢复正确边缘速度场」的兼容性条件与按速度大小/方向区分权重的损失，可供核查训练目标是否会系统偏离期望的 latent 轨迹分布。
